Big feature drop — closes most of the dashboard parity gap vs the old homepage-style setups. Search, layout options, Docker import, SSO, API tokens, kiosk/share links, and iframe embeds are all in this build.

### Added — Dashboard UX

* **Global search bar** — filter apps on the fly, or flip to **Web** mode and search Google / DuckDuckGo / Bing from the same input
* **Keyboard shortcuts** — `Ctrl+K` or `/` focus search, `Esc` clears, `1`–`9` jump category tabs, `?` shows the cheat sheet
* **Dashboard layout** — **Settings → Appearance → Layout**: category **tabs** (default) or **collapsible sections**
* **Status page** — `/status` and `/api/status` aggregate app health from webhook pollers
* **Dashboard widgets** — **Settings → Widgets** tab: add notes/HTML blocks, reorder, delete
* **Per-app guest visibility** — checkbox on Add/Edit App; guests only see cards you allow

### Added — Discovery & embeds

* **Docker app discovery** — agent reads `amud.enable`, `amud.url`, `amud.name`, `amud.icon` labels; **Settings → Integrations → Scan Docker** then bulk import
* **Iframe embed mode** — per-app **Embed in dashboard** option; `/embed/:id` panel with tab links; CSP `frame-src` allowlist when enabled in Security settings

### Added — Auth & API

* **OIDC / SSO** — **Settings → Security**: issuer, client ID/secret, redirect URI; login page **Sign in with SSO** button
* **API tokens** — create read-only Bearer tokens (`read:apps`, `read:status`) for scripts and external tools
* **Kiosk mode** — hide sign-in for wall displays; **share links** (`/s/:token`) for read-only dashboard views with optional category scope

### Fixed / housekeeping

* Rust CI: clippy + `cargo audit` (oauth2 without bundled rustls 0.21)
* SonarCloud quality gate on new parity code

### Install / Upgrade

Proxmox / bare metal:

```bash
curl -sSL https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/releases/latest/download/update-amud.sh | bash
```

Docker / Unraid:

```bash
docker compose pull && docker compose up -d --force-recreate
```

Hard-refresh after upgrade (`Ctrl+Shift+R`). **Settings → System** should show `v1.5.5.4`.

**Heads-up:** OIDC and share links need correct public URL / redirect URI in settings. Docker discovery needs the host agent running with access to the Docker socket and labeled containers.
